question: How is the teacher lineage structured when it is grounded in Shiva knowledge?
premises: The teacher lineage is mutually connected.
It is established in knowledge of Shiva.
When so established, it involves a primary cause and an assisting cause in a threefold structure.
inference: The teacher lineage functions through an ordered structure of primary and assisting causes grounded in Shiva knowledge.
uncertainties: The exact threefold division is clarified in the next verse.
plain_english: The teacher lineage, mutually connected and established in knowledge of Shiva, stands in this way as a threefold structure with a primary cause and an assisting cause.
